<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="accent" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.12"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="19" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="323" y1="17" x2="323" y2="13" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="17" x2="328" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="333" y1="17" x2="333" y2="9" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="347" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="17" x2="354" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="361" y="9" width="19" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="11" width="14" height="6" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="380" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- header -->
  <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="66" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="29,62 21,70 29,78" fill="none" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="70" x2="39" y2="70" stroke="#4A4A4A" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="195" y="74" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Cash Out</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="95" x2="390" y2="95" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- balance section -->
  <text x="24" y="128" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#939393">AVAILABLE BALANCE</text>
  <text x="24" y="169" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="34" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">$20.00</text>
  <rect x="303" y="139" width="63" height="25" rx="13" fill="#96E063" opacity="0.2"/>
  <text x="334" y="156" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">READY</text>

  <!-- payout card -->
  <rect x="20" y="191" width="350" height="141" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="20" y="187" width="350" height="141" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <circle cx="54" cy="222" r="22" fill="url(#accent)"/>
  <rect x="43" y="214" width="22" height="15" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="219" x2="64" y2="219" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="48" y1="224" x2="54" y2="224" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="88" y="217" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Instant transfer</text>
  <text x="88" y="238" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Debit card •••• 4821</text>
  <rect x="282" y="207" width="67" height="24" rx="12" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
  <text x="315" y="223" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">1–2 MIN</text>
  <line x1="42" y1="260" x2="348" y2="260" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="42" y="285" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Transfer amount</text>
  <text x="348" y="285" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">$20.00</text>
  <text x="42" y="307" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Instant transfer fee</text>
  <text x="348" y="307" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#EA5D6B">-$0.50</text>

  <!-- receive summary -->
  <rect x="20" y="350" width="350" height="67" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="42" y="378" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">You’ll receive</text>
  <text x="348" y="382" text-anchor="end" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">$19.50</text>
  <text x="42" y="399" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Funds sent instantly after confirmation</text>

  <!-- eligibility notice -->
  <rect x="20" y="438" width="350" height="76" rx="13" fill="#96E063" opacity="0.18"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="476" r="15" fill="#96E063"/>
  <polyline points="41,476 46,481 55,470" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="75" y="468" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">You’re eligible to cash out</text>
  <text x="75" y="490" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Your linked debit card is ready to receive funds.</text>

  <!-- terms -->
  <text x="24" y="551" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#4A4A4A">Before you confirm</text>
  <circle cx="29" cy="573" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
  <text x="39" y="577" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Instant transfers are non-refundable.</text>
  <circle cx="29" cy="596" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
  <text x="39" y="600" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">The $0.50 fee is deducted from your balance.</text>
  <circle cx="29" cy="619" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
  <text x="39" y="623" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">By continuing, you agree to the payout terms.</text>

  <!-- confirm button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="57" y="649" width="276" height="44" rx="22" fill="url(#accent)"/>
    <text x="195" y="676" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">CONFIRM $19.50</text>
  </g>

  <!-- navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="767" width="390" height="77" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="767" x2="390" y2="767" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <rect x="39" y="782" width="20" height="16" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="36,782 49,771 62,782" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="49" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="128" cy="783" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="135" y1="790" x2="142" y2="797" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="128" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Discover</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="207" y="775" width="25" height="18" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <polygon points="211,793 211,798 217,793" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="214" cy="784" r="1.3" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="784" r="1.3" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="226" cy="784" r="1.3" fill="#939393"/>
    <text x="220" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="311" cy="780" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="311" cy="795" rx="12" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="311" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#FE3675">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <!-- home indicator -->
  <rect x="145" y="832" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
